corrections.reason: Both the zoomed image and canonical Ge'ez 3 John 1:15 ('greet our friends by name') clearly show ቢጸነ (our companions/friends), where the vowel leg on ቢ and the three-loop head of ጸ were misread as በይነ.

The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads ግብረ (accusative of ግብር, matching ወዘንተ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ግብረ in Col 3 L05-06 and the Amharic translation ይህን ፡ በጎውን ፡ ሥራ in Col 4 L34-35), which was misread as ግበሪ due to slight ink wear on ብ and ረ.
